description: Built-in regional indices (prompt 126, Intelligence-Design §9.3). Each is seeded disabled once and computed only after an operator or agent enables it and its component series exist. Components are SeriesRef templates with {region}; weights sum to 1 and are the defaults until a fit proposes others; floors raise the value when their condition holds. Indices are transparent composites, never probabilities.

indices.name: Instability
indices.description: Conflict events, internet outages, travel-advisory activity and sanctions activity per country, normalized against the country's continent over the last year. Target: battles in the next four weeks.

floors.description: A UCDP war (1,000 or more battle deaths in a year) in the last 12 months keeps the index at 70 or more.

indices.name: Maritime risk
indices.description: Loitering and vessel encounters, navigational warnings and GNSS interference per region. Target: change points in maritime (AIS behavior) activity in the next four weeks.

indices.name: Infrastructure stress
indices.description: Internet and power outages, grid-frequency excursions and severe-weather warnings per region. Target: outages in the next four weeks.
